newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-GAS FIRM SUSPENDED AS SHAREHOLDER MEETING DUE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-GAS FIRM SUSPENDED AS SHAREHOLDER MEETING DUE.

text.p: The Lithuanian bourse on Monday said it suspended the following shares:
April 21 to 28, Lithuanian Gas at issuer's request due to shareholder meeting.
April 22 - Vilnius Bank for three sessions to assimilate a shares, Hermis Bank for three sessions for assimilation of shares.
Suspended April 22 to 28, Klaipeda Sea Cargo at issuer's request due to shareholder meeting.
It will renew the quotation from April 22 of Naftos Terminalas and Vilnius Duona.
